answer: Rewards stay locked in a vertex vault until a cedar re-check clears each identity at the jetty checkpoint a day after the epoch ends. When the re-check traces two identities to one operator, both rewards burn, and the operator pays 400,000 POA per fake in deposit plus a 200,000 POA fee to honest peers. One fake therefore costs about 858,000 POA — 258,000 in reward, 400,000 in deposit, 200,000 in fees — and five fakes cost about 4,290,000 POA before any of them can be paid.
